Anarchie ist ein fortlaufender Prozess zur Demontage von Autorität.

Anarchie ist die unerbittliche Verneinung von Herrschaftsstrukturen, das Bestreben, sich kleine Bereiche des Lebens frei von Ausbeutung und Leid zu schaffen.

Anarchie ist der kompromisslose Vorstoß gegen Unterdrückung und die lautstarke Forderung nach Autonomie und Selbstbestimmung, die Ablehnung aller Klassen, Institutionen und Dogmen, die geschaffen wurden, um Menschen zu beherrschen.

Anarchie ist vor allem eine Praxis, nicht eine Theorie. Es geht darum, aktiv daran zu arbeiten, autoritäre Verhältnisse zu beenden, wo immer sie existieren, und nicht-autoritäre Alternativen aufzubauen. Es geht nicht darum, eine Lebensweise für einen imaginären Ort, eine imaginäre Zeit und imaginäre Menschen vorzuschreiben. Es geht um reale Menschen und die Bewältigung realer Probleme.

Anarchie ist eine lebendige und atmende Praxis, die wir in unser tägliches Leben einbauen. Eine persönliche Haltung gegen die Herrschaft, die alle unsere Entscheidungen beeinflusst und so den Verlauf unserer Existenz prägt.

Es gibt kein Endziel für Anarchie. Sie ist ein fortwährender, nicht enden wollender Kampf gegen hierarchische Strukturen und die Autoritätspersonen, die im Luxus an der Spitze dieser Strukturen sitzen.

Anarchie ist der Wunsch nach Freiheit von Tyrannei. Anarchie sind unzählige Generationen verschiedener Menschen mit dem Drang, freier zu sein als sie es unter den Systemen sind, die sie gewaltsam regieren.

Anarchie ist die Ablehnung der Regierung, der Staaten, der Grenzen, des Kapitals, des Patriarchats, des Gender-Essenzialismus, der Sklaverei, der Ideologie, der Rechten, der Linken, des Klerus, der Demokratie, des Privateigentums, der Technokratie, der Kernfamilie, des Humanismus, des Imperialismus, der Gefängnisse, der Fabriken, der Gründerväter, der Bürokratie, der Ethnokratie, der Heteronormativität, der Idole, der Tradition, der Polizeiarbeit, der Neuronormativität, des Ökozids, der Zivilisation und jeder anderen Form von Autorität.

Anarchie ist Gemeinschaftsgärten, Umsonstläden, Graffiti, 3D-gedruckte Waffen, FKK, vegane Potlucks [1], Hausbesetzungen, Lebensmittelwälder, Sabotage von Pipelines, freie Software, die Befreiung von Kühen, Ladendiebstahl, das Sichern von Saatgut alter Kulturpflanzen, die Bildung autonomer Zonen, Attentate auf Tyrannen, Guerilla-Gärtnern, Zines schreiben, Regenwasser auffangen, Wahlurnen verbrennen, Biodiversität, Abschaffung der Whiteness, Hacken, Aquaponik, Musik machen, Upcycling, Polizeistationen abfackeln und Wildblumen in der ganzen Landschaft säen.

Anarchist*innen sind jene Personen, die sich weigern, von irgendjemandem oder irgendetwas regiert, beherrscht oder dominiert zu werden. Anarchist*innen sind wütende, verbitterte, verlorene, ängstliche, desillusionierte, gewalttätige, friedliche, mutige, idealistische, mitreißende, furchtlose Träumende.

Ein*e Anarchist*in steht allein gegen die riesige Flut der Autorität, die in alle Richtungen ansteigt. Anarchist*innen verbinden sich mit jeder geschundenen, geknechteten Seele im gemeinsamen Angriff gegen die rücksichtslosen Systeme, die uns entmachten und entfremden sollen.

Anarchie ist geprägt von endlosen Widersprüchen, existenzieller Angst und unerträglichen inneren Konflikten, und doch ergibt Anarchie für jede Person, die entsetzt oder wütend ist über die groben Ungerechtigkeiten, die diesen kleinen blauen Planeten verschlingen, einen perfekten Sinn. Anarchie ist für jede Person, die ein Leben in Würde anstrebt.

Anarchie ist ein unmögliches, absonderliches, aber für unser Überleben notwendiges Streben.

author: Archipelago Anarchist Archive
title: Archipelago Anarchist Archive, Perpustakaan Anarkis, and Anarsip: Jurnal Arsip & Perpustakaan Anti-otoritarian (A Brief Introduction)
content:
Initiatives in anarchist archiving, librarianship, and journals of archives & libraries in Indonesia

The Archipelago Anarchist Archive (AAA) is an informal, alternative archives and library initiative established in 2024 with the aim of preserving and distributing anti-authoritarian materials. AAA is driven by a number of anarchist archivists and librarians from various cities in Indonesia.

The materials that AAA focuses on are those produced in, and related to, the archipelago (known as Indonesia), whether in Indonesian or in non-Indonesian languages. These materials can take the form of texts, photographs, audio, video, and so on. All of AAA's digital archive collections can be accessed through the Internet Archive.

Link to the Archipelago Anarchist Archive collection: https://archive.org/details/@archipelago-anti-authoritarian-archive

Perpustakaan Anarkis (Anarchist Library) is an preservation and distribution project for anti-authoritarian materials based on plain text. Plain text was chosen because it makes it easier for authors and translators to distribute their work, easier for publishers to reproduce it, and easier for those who wish to archive it[1]. Perpustakaan Anarkis understands anti-authoritarianism in a flexible manner, though not without limits. Therefore, it can be said that Perpustakaan Anarkis accepts and includes both anarchist materials (from all tendencies, except anarcho-capitalism and anarcho-nationalism) and materials that can enrich anarchism, such as avant-garde(ism) that challenges not only the boundaries of art but also the state and centralized power, libertarian Marxism, autonomism, democratic confederalism, and so on. In addition, Perpustakaan Anarkis also accepts and includes reportage from the front lines (confrontation) and the home front (care) of flashpoints of popular struggle and resistance, labor strikes, and so on.

Because in anarchism, decentralization and prefiguration are important. And by practicing decentralization and prefiguration, we (and us all) no longer need to wait to act and be overly dependent on a single central point.

Besides anarcho-capitalism and anarcho-nationalism, Perpustakaan Anarkis is also not intended for authoritarian Marxists, misanthropic individuals, extractive technologism (automation that subordinates), avant-garde(ism) that leads to fascism, and other authoritarian tendencies and centralized power.

[1] Authors and translators can distribute their works without the hassle of layout, editing, cover design, and other technical work. Conversely, publishers no longer need to go through the trouble of dealing with writing and translation. And archivists—in addition to finding archiving easier—will receive various versions of the work.

Link to the Perpustakaan Anarkis collection: https://id.anarchistlibraries.net/special/index

Anarsip: Jurnal Arsip & Perpustakaan Anti-otoritarian (Anarsip: Journal of Anti-authoritarian Archives & Libraries) (published periodically, every 6 months) is a space for theorizing–practicing–theorizing–practicing anarchist archives and librarianship. Because we believe that anarchist archives and librarianship should not stop at merely the definition of "managed by, and archiving materials of, anarchist(s) and/or anti-authoritarian [movements and ideas]," but also means using methods, practicing ways of working, and thinking in an anarchist and/or anti-authoritarian manner. If the Situationist International said "to be avant-garde is to move in step with reality" (Internationale Situationiste #8); then we say "to be anarchist archiving and librarianship is to move in step with reality and anarchism."

Link to follow the developments of Anarsip: https://id.anarchistlibraries.net/special/anarsip-jurnal-arsip-perpustakaan-anti-otoritarian

Archipelago Anarchist Archive (AAA) adalah inisiatif pengarsipan dan perpustakaan informal nan alternatif yang didirikan pada tahun 2024 dengan tujuan mempreservasi sekaligus mendistribusi materi-materi anti-otoritarian. AAA digerakkan oleh sejumlah arsiparis dan pustakawan anarkis yang berasal dari berbagai kota di Indonesia.

Adapun materi-materi yang menjadi fokus dari AAA adalah materi-materi yang diproduksi di, dan yang berkaitan dengan, wilayah kepulauan (yang kini disebut sebagai Indonesia) baik itu yang berbahasa Indonesia maupun yang berbahasa non-indonesia. Dan materi-materi tersebut bisa berupa teks, foto, audio, video, dan lain sebagainya. Semua koleksi arsip digital AAA …

The Anarchist Network of “Vancouver Island” (“Victoria”) remembers our comrade Tasha Diamant fondly.

Tasha was a passionate ecological artist, firebrand sneaky actionist, a loving mother, rageful ecofeminist, and matriarch of the Network.

Tasha was an ardent revolutionary mother who fought against patriarchy, hierarchy, and colonization. She was a prolific organizer and consciousness raiser in “Victoria” (Lekwungen), anchoring major in-city supports and disruptions to bolster direct actions against domination in all its forms.

She also spearheaded The Human Body Project to rouse consciousness; in a misogynistic, dissociative society. She at the time did not have words for what she later understood simply as a violent culture, instead using her naked body to share and create space for vulnerability and a process of bearing witness to self participation in estrangement.

These consciousness raising efforts culminated in hundreds of street actions and performances. This work also extended itself into Humans of Fairy Creek, a theatrical series that focused on humanizing the thousands of arrestees in the struggle ignored by the self-appointed hierarchics in the Fairy Creek leadership.

While Tasha herself did not identify as an anarchist, (preferring the label ‘ecofeminist’) she was most often aligned with anti-patriarchal, anti-capitalist, and anti-hierarchical modes of organizing.

Tasha started FreeSkool Victoria in 2022, was involved in the ‘Victoria’ Anarchist Bookfair Collective in 2023, and supporting the People’s Park Palestine liberation encampment on the University of Victoria quad in 2025 through an “Elders” affinity group she started.

Upon connecting with anarchist youths (note from some youths: we playfully called ourselves “strays”) here, she explained:

“This whole time, in my whole life, no one told me the Anarchists were always there. I wish I’d found you all sooner.” When Tasha learned about the anarchist Mujeres Libres (Free Women) of the Spanish Revolution, she lamented she “would’ve surely joined and stood with them.”

Tasha also understood the privatized Victorian city as a collection of open canvasses that ‘ought to be reclaimed from “fuckers,” painting sanctioned murals and unsanctioned guerrilla artworks around the city. She was also a talented and seamless acquirer and redistributor of various goods to poor folks.

Tasha volunteered with William Head on Stage (WHoS, the only prison theatre company in ‘Canada’) for a number of years. She was blacklisted from volunteering at William Head Institution when the administration decided they did not approve of her friendships with incarcerated artists, as well as conducting The Human Body Project outside the prison, after arbitrary and misogynistic police interventions in street demos. Her shortfilm Handcuffed (2020) documents one of these interactions.

Tasha was an underappreciated …

content:
Auteur·e

: Agustín Guillamón

Titre

: Les comités de défense de la CNT à Barcelone (1933-1938)

Date

: 2017


 Tampon du Comité de Défense Local de Barcelone


LES COMITÉS DE DÉFENSE DE LA CNT À BARCELONE (1933-1938)


 Des Cadres de Défense aux Comités révolutionnaires de Quartier, aux Patrouilles de contrôle et aux Milices Populaires


AGUSTÍN GUILLAMÓN


 Première édition en espagnol : avril 2011. Seconde édition en espagnol : septembre 2011. Aldarull edicions. Barcelone.


 Ce livre a été traduit par le Collectif Anarchiste de Traduction et de Scannérisation (CATS) de Caen (et d’ailleurs) en avril et mai 2012, avec le concours précieux de l’auteur. Merci à S. de “La Bataille Socialiste” (

http://bataillesocialiste.wordpress.com/

) pour la mise en relation avec l’auteur. D’autres traductions subversives du CATS sont librement téléchargeables et diffusables sur son site :

http://ablogm.com/cats/


 Un premier brouillon initial (très bref) de ce travail fut publié dans le numéro extraordinaire de Solidaridad Obrera (janvier 2010) dédié au centenaire de la CNT.


 Plus de dirigeants, plus d’État Pour profiter de nos combats.


 — Raoul Vaneigem, La vie s’écoule, la vie s’enfuit


 Vivere militare est.


 — Sénèque. Lettres


 I didn’t say it would be easy, Neo. I just said it would be the truth.


 — Morpheus dans Matrix, Larry et Andy Wachowski.


 « Les révolutions sociales, ces tentatives de réorganisation de la production et de la société sur des nouvelles bases, sont extrêmement rares dans l’Histoire. Au delà des circonstances particulières dans lesquelles elles surgirent, elles nous apportent toujours une expérience irremplaçable, dans leurs succès comme, surtout, dans leurs échecs. Le grand enseignement de la révolution de 1936 a été la nécessité incontournable de la destruction de l’État ».


 Barricade construite le 19 Juillet 1936 sur le Paralelo, face à « El Molino ». Ici les Comités de Défense et le Syndicat du Bois de la CNT mirent en déroute l’armée soulevée.


1. DU RAPPORT DE SHAPIRO À CELUI D’OCTOBRE 1934


 Un rapport confidentiel, à la diffusion réduite, d’Alexandre Shapiro

[1]

, secrétaire de l’AIT, élaboré durant son séjour en Espagne en 1932-33, relatait ce qu’étaient et comment fonctionnaient les Comités de Défense, organisés exclusivement pour des tâches insurrectionnelles de choc, comme celle du 8 janvier 1933, dont il fut témoin. Ce rapport de Shapiro, sur les Comités de Défense, fut réalisé en pleine polémique entre FAIstes et trentistes

[2]

 sur l’opportunité, ou non, de la tactique d’insurrection immédiate, localiste et permanente. Shapiro fit une critique dévastatrice de l’improvisation, du manque d’organisation et de préparation de l’insurrection de janvier. Il dénonça, avec dureté, le fait qu’une même personne puisse détenir des charges aux secrétariats de la CNT et du Comité National de Défense, pour le confusionnisme que cela créait. Il démontra que, dans la pratique, s’était produite une soumission de la CNT aux décisions du Comité National des Comités de Défense (CNDC).


 Le rapport de Shapiro, qui bénéficiait de l’aide inestimable d’Eusebio Carbó, décrivait de cette manière les Cadres de Défense, existants en 1933 : « Ces Comités de Défense, qui existaient déjà depuis un certain temps, avaient comme unique but de préparer les armes nécessaires en cas d’insurrection, d’organiser les groupes de choc dans les différents quartiers populaires, d’organiser la résistance des soldats dans les casernes etc… ».


 Alors même que l’insurrection des Asturies était encore en cours, le CNCD constatait, dans un rapport

[3]

, l’échec de la tactique insurrectionnelle, défendue par le groupe Nosotros, connue populairement sous le nom de « gymnastique révolutionnaire », qu’il accusait précisément d’être responsable du manque de préparation de la CNT pour intervenir, au niveau national, dans l’insurrection d’octobre 1934. Le moment était venu de dépasser cette tactique, parce qu’elle avait démontré le caractère absurde et dangereux d’une insurrection locale à un moment inadéquat, sans une sérieuse préparation préalable, qui soumettait les libertaires à la répression étatique, sans jamais obtenir une extension populaire à tout le pays, ni l’adhésion des autres organisations, nécessaire pour affronter avec succès l’appareil militaire et répressif de l’État. Le pire de tout est que cette répression avait démantelé l’appareil militaire clandestin de la CNT, après les insurrections …

title: Hesekê Asayish Command: Two of our members killed in bomb attack
content:
A security centre belonging to the Internal Security Forces, located in the Mişêrfê neighbourhood of Hesekê, was targeted in an attack involving a bomb-laden motorcycle.


In a statement on the attack, the Internal Security Forces (Asayish) Command said that ISIS cells had targeted the security centre using three motorcycles rigged with explosives.


The Asayish Command confirmed that two of its members had been killed, and five others wounded in the attack.

title: KNK calls on Southern Kurdistan’s political parties to protect national gains
content:
The Executive Council of the Kurdistan National Congress (KNK) issued a statement concerning the protection of the constitutional rights and powers of the Kurdistan Region.


The KNK said it had been closely following the Iraqi Prime Minister’s recent remarks, and drew attention to statements and initiatives aimed at restricting the management of oil, natural resources and other revenues.


Emphasising the need for political and economic stability in both federal Iraq and the Kurdistan Region, the statement said that Iraq’s strength and the continuation of its democratic system depend on respecting the will of the people and protecting everyone's constitutional rights.


Pointing out that the Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG) is the result of the Kurdish people's struggle and the sacrifices made by the people of Kurdistan, the statement said: "Any attempt to undermine the constitutional rights of the Kurdistan Region regarding oil and non-oil revenues contradicts the principles of federalism and cooperation and will weaken the understanding and trust between Erbil and Baghdad.


We also emphasise that the Kurdistan Region's share of the Iraqi budget, as well as the salaries and financial entitlements of employees and citizens in Kurdistan, must not be entangled in political disputes. These must be guaranteed as fundamental constitutional rights."


The statement also said that, in order to strengthen stability in Iraq, Article 140 of the 2005 Constitution of the Federal Republic of Iraq must be fully implemented. This is necessary to normalise the situation in the Kurdish territories outside the Kurdistan Region and to put an end to policies of demographic change and marginalisation.


The KNK called on the President of Iraq, the Speaker of Parliament, the Prime Minister and the Iraqi Federal Government to address the rights of the Kurdistan Region within the constitutional framework and with a sense of responsibility. It added that a proper solution could be achieved through constructive national dialogue.


The statement concluded with the following appeal: "We call on all political forces and parties in Kurdistan, particularly the Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP) and the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK), as well as all citizens, to resolve their internal conflicts and disagreements and to act in unity, with a common national position and the highest sense of responsibility, in order to protect our constitutional gains and the status of the Kurdistan Region."

title: KCK on the 48th anniversary of the PKK’s founding: A new beginning in the freedom struggle
content:
The Co-Presidency of the Executive Council of the Kurdistan Communities Union (KCK) issued a statement on the occasion of the 48th anniversary of the founding of the Kurdistan Workers’ Party (PKK). In the statement, the KCK reviewed the historical achievements of the movement led by the PKK and placed the party’s dissolution and the transition to a new political strategy of struggle within the continuity of the Kurdish freedom struggle.


The KCK statement on Thursday reads as follows:


“We congratulate Leader Apo [Abdullah Öcalan], our people, their friends, and all forces engaged in the struggle on the 48th anniversary of the founding of the PKK. We commemorate with gratitude and respect our martyrs, who made the emergence of the PKK and its 52-year struggle possible.


Leader Apo initiated the efforts to establish the party in memory of our esteemed martyr Haki Karer. On November 27, 1978, he convened the first congress and founded the PKK, which would go on to lead the struggle of the Kurdish people.


The PKK has led the longest-running freedom struggle in the history of the Kurdish people. Under its leadership, profound transformations have taken place among the Kurdish people, the likes of which have not been seen anywhere else in the world. The Kurdish people were raised from their deathbed and became the most dynamic force for freedom in the Middle East. The Kurds, once regarded as backward, have now become a shining example not only for the Middle East but for the entire world.


Our homeland, once regarded as a buried, imaginary Kurdistan, is now a region where an exceptionally vibrant freedom struggle is being waged. All the achievements and the strength of resistance in Northern, Southern, Eastern, and Western Kurdistan are owed to the freedom struggle led by the PKK.


The Kurdish people’s freedom struggle has faced attacks on a scale unprecedented anywhere in the world. We have lost tens of thousands of martyrs, while hundreds of thousands of Kurds have been subjected to severe torture and thrown into prison. The Kurds have set a record in world history for political imprisonment. Thousands of villages were burned down and destroyed, and Kurdistan was depopulated. Nevertheless, the freedom struggle led by the PKK continued uninterrupted for 52 years and achieved tremendous gains.


As the freedom struggle repelled all attacks aimed at its annihilation, the Turkish state found itself facing serious problems both domestically and internationally. Under conditions of non-conflict, it entered into a process of political discussions with our freedom movement. State representatives held dozens of talks with Leader Apo on Imrali. Delegations from the Kurdish side also participated in these talks.


The fact that the Turkish state, which has long denied the existence of the Kurdish people and sought to subject them to physical and cultural genocide, recognizes Leader Apo and our movement as interlocutors is a significant political development. All the talks on Imrali are also being conducted as a form of political struggle.

We now have a leader who guides not only the Kurdish people but also the pursuit of a free and democratic life in the Middle East and throughout the world. We have a leader who is supported by women because he has developed a path toward women’s liberation. We have a leader who has developed a new social science. title: HPG: Our determination to carry our people’s struggle to victory is stronger than ever
content:
The HPG (People’s Defense Forces) Press Liaison Center released a statement marking the 48th anniversary of the founding of the PKK (Kurdistan Workers’ Party)


The HPG statement on Thursday includes the following:


“Happy National Resistance Day and the 48th anniversary of the founding of the PKK to Leader Apo [Abdullah Öcalan], the leader, founder, first self-sacrificing militant, and greatest contributor to our Freedom Movement; to the families of our martyrs, our patriotic people, the valued friends of our people, the prison resistance fighters, and all our comrades struggling in every sphere!


The PKK is a Party of Martyrs that emerged on the basis of keeping alive the memory of Comrade Haki Karer and fulfilling his goals, and has pursued this cause without interruption for half a century.


The Army of Martyrs, which pioneered the PKK, has, throughout 48 years of struggle, created great values, honorable principles, profound human virtues, high moral and spiritual values, the Apoist spirit of self-sacrifice, and a life so meaningful that it is worth dying for. These sacred values of ours have taken concrete form in the path of the martyrs as our most fundamental source of strength. We commemorate with respect, love, and gratitude all our revered martyrs who created this reality through their sweat, lives, and blood, represented by our great Party Martyr, Comrade Haki Karer.


Forty-eight years ago, the Kurdish people were on the brink of extinction. They faced a reality marked by policies of denial, annihilation, and genocide, in which their very existence had become a matter of debate and even imagining independence and freedom was out of the question. Rescuing the Kurdish people from this situation, shaking off the dust of death that had settled over them, raising them to their feet, breathing life into them, giving them the will to act, enabling them to struggle, proving their existence, and leading them toward freedom required an extremely arduous resistance.


At the same time, there was a need for courageous cadres with an iron will and a spirit of self-sacrifice who could lead this historic resistance, shoulder the burden of the oppressed Kurdish people who had been left without support and of the Kurdistan Freedom Struggle, assume this responsibility, and carry the struggle forward.


Recognizing this historical reality, Leader Apo made a historic breakthrough alongside the Apoists he had organized around him. On November 27, 1978, in the village of Fis in the Lice district of Amed, he made the decision for the Kurdish people’s National Resistance and founded the PKK, which would lead our national resistance.


Every year, every month, every day, and even every hour of this half-century-long epic National Resistance Struggle has been etched into history through magnificent acts of resistance and heroism. Apoists who joined this struggle from all parts of Kurdistan, from abroad, and from other peoples demonstrated unprecedented resistance and heroism, creating an entirely new history and a new reality for the people. Leader Apo’s emergence marked a turning point in Kurdistan. The PKK’s struggle said “stop” to the policies of denial, annihilation, and genocide. Through its relentless resistance, it proved the existence of the Kurdish nation and compelled everyone to acknowledge it.


It brought about a profound revolution in understanding, conscience, and mentality in Kurdistan. It created an entirely new language, culture, discourse, style, and pace. It established the ethics and principles of a free life. Through the intellectual and social revolution it fostered among the Kurdish people, the National Resistance Struggle led by the PKK completely changed and transformed society. By carrying out a revolution within the revolution, it brought forth the reality of free women. This reality took shape as a guerrilla force, developed into an army and a party, and became a guiding philosophy, a set of principles, and a science.


Throughout our 48-year National Resistance Struggle, we have lost nearly 50,000 martyrs, including the PKK’s founding leadership cadres, pioneers, guerrillas, fighters, militia members, friends, and civilians. Each of our martyrs demonstrated extraordinary courage and became a monument of honor in whom we take eternal pride, our most sacred value, and an immortal pioneer who continues to guide us. title: Nine intact skulls and hundreds of bone fragments recovered from cave in Silvan
content:
Following the discovery of numerous human remains in a cave in the Silvan district of Amed (Diyarbakır) province, initial findings have emerged from the crime scene investigation ordered by the prosecutor’s office. Nine intact skulls, 36 skull fragments, and hundreds of other bone fragments were recovered from the cave. The identities of the deceased, as well as the dates and circumstances of their deaths, remain unknown.


The Human Rights Association (IHD), the Association of Lawyers for Freedom (ÖHD), and the Amed Bar Association provided information on the progress of the investigation at a joint press conference held at the IHD offices. Given the history of state violence and enforced disappearances in the region, the organizations consider the discovery particularly significant for efforts to address the past.


Prosecutor’s office notified following tip-off from local residents


Zeynep Karayılan, Co-Chair of the ÖHD in Amed, reported that a delegation from the three organizations had conducted an initial on-site investigation on November 19 following a tip-off from local residents received by the IHD. During the investigation, numerous human bones and skulls were discovered and documented on different levels of the three-story cave.


On November 23, the organizations contacted the prosecutor’s office in Silvan and requested the launch of a comprehensive investigation. That same evening, the Turkish gendarmerie informed the organizations that a crime scene investigation had been scheduled for the following day. An eleven-member delegation from the IHD, ÖHD, and the Amed and Mardin bar associations subsequently went to the Bayrampaşa Gendarmerie Station on November 24. However, only one representative from each organization was permitted to participate in the investigation.


Recovery operation under difficult conditions


The cave is located in a rural area known locally as Qesra Fila, according to the bar association. The area is accessible by off-road vehicles and is also frequented by people engaged in livestock farming in the surrounding area. After the site was secured and searched for possible explosive devices, ventilation measures were initiated.


The entrance to the cave is extremely narrow, and its three levels extend deep underground. Due to these conditions, representatives of the legal organizations were unable to enter the cave themselves and observed the operation from outside. Under the supervision of two prosecutors, four forensic crime scene investigators and two members of the Disaster and Emergency Management Authority (AFAD) descended into the cave. The low oxygen levels, particularly on the third level, made the recovery operation difficult.


Nine skulls, hundreds of bone fragments, and a blue button


Human remains were found on all three levels of the cave. In addition to nine intact skulls, 36 skull fragments, and hundreds of other bone fragments, a blue button was also recovered. Soil samples were also collected from all three levels. The recovery operation was documented through photographs and video recordings.


The work at the site ended at approximately 5:15 p.m. The recovered items, secured in a total of seven bags, were then taken to the central gendarmerie station in Silvan. There, the human remains were counted, sorted, and documented in the presence of prosecutors and representatives of the legal organizations.


Müslüm Dalar, a board member of the Amed Bar Association, announced at the press conference that the human remains have since been transferred to the state-run Forensic Medicine Institute (ATK) in Istanbul. The forensic examinations conducted there are expected to shed light on the age of the bones, the identities of the deceased, and the circumstances of their deaths.


The history of enforced disappearances in Silvan


For the human rights and lawyers’ organizations, it is crucial that the investigation not be limited to the forensic identification of the deceased.


Karayılan stated: “At present, it is, of course, not yet known to whom the bones belong, what period they date from, or under what circumstances these people lost their lives. However, the fact that such remains have been discovered in Silvan, where enforced disappearances, unsolved murders, and serious human rights violations occurred on a large scale, particularly in the 1990s, is of extraordinary significance for investigating past events that still remain unresolved.”

title: Processo Sovrano: 30 novembre, tutti e tutte in aula!
content:
IL 30 NOVEMBRE CI SIAMO TUTT*: LE ARRINGHE DELLA DIFESA NEL PROCESSO SOVRANO


da

Notav.info


Lunedì 30 novembre

, dopo mesi di udienze, testimonianze, requisitorie e richieste di condanna, sarà il momento delle 

arringhe finali della difesa

. Un passaggio importante, forse decisivo, di un processo che non ha mai riguardato soltanto gl* imputat* del 

processo Sovrano

, ma una stagione di lotte, una comunità, un modo di stare al mondo. 


Questo processo, fin dall’inizio, ha avuto un significato che va ben oltre le singole imputazioni. Nel primo grado, il tribunale aveva 

assolto tutt dall’accusa di associazione a delinquere

*, concentrandosi su singoli episodi di lotta dispensando pene sicuramente elevate. 


La Procura, però, non si è arresa. Ha impugnato quella sentenza e in appello ha riproposto il proprio teorema, tornando a chiedere che il 

conflitto sociale

venga riconosciuto come un 

disegno criminale

. Quella di 

associazione a delinquere

 si è confermata un’accusa costruita per ricondurre esperienze differenti, lotte diverse, relazioni politiche e percorsi di militanza a un’unica presunta organizzazione criminale. 


Nelle ultime udienze abbiamo ascoltato le requisitorie, le richieste di condanna, la pretesa di trasformare ancora una volta le nostre lotte in una 

questione di ordine pubblico

. Abbiamo sentito evocare persino le 

mobilitazioni future

, come se il problema non fossero soltanto i fatti contestati, ma la possibilità che domani qualcun* torni a scendere in strada, a organizzarsi, a protestare.


Ecco, forse è proprio questo il 

cuore politico

 del 

processo Sovrano

. Si vuole colpire la capacità delle persone di unirsi, di riconoscersi, di costruire insieme un’alternativa. Si vuole dire a chi lotta che il 

prezzo da pagare

 può essere altissimo, che la 

solidarietà

 può diventare un’accusa, che l’

organizzazione collettiva

 può essere trasformata in un 

sospetto permanente

. 


Ma noi sappiamo bene da dove veniamo.


Veniamo dalla 

Val di Susa

, da una lotta che ha saputo resistere per decenni a un’opera imposta, devastante, inutile. Veniamo da strade, piazze, boschi, assemblee, occupazioni, spazi sociali. Veniamo da esperienze diverse che si sono incontrate, riconosciute, sostenute. Veniamo da una 

storia fatta di persone, non di teoremi

. E guardiamo al futuro, insieme alle migliaia di persone che oggi in tutto il paese continuano a scendere in piazza e chiedere un cambiamento, quello sì 

radicale

. 


E in questa storia ci sono anche gl* imputat* di questo processo. Persone con cui abbiamo percorso i sentieri delle nostre montagne, costruito presidi, il festival, marce infinite e momenti conviviali. A loro vorrebbero dare delle 

condanne esemplari

 perché hanno scelto di lottare. 


In questi anni la 

solidarietà

 è stata una 

forza concreta

. È stata una mano tesa, una telefonata, una presenza fuori dal tribunale, parole dette al momento giusto. È stata la certezza che, anche quando lo Stato prova a isolarti, c’è una 

comunità che non ti lascia indietro

. Per questo, non lasciamo che le arringhe della difesa siano soltanto un passaggio tecnico. Facciamone un 

momento collettivo

, un 

appuntamento di solidarietà

. 

Perché le lotte non si processano!


Lunedì 30 novembre, tutt al processo Sovrano. 

Ci vediamo in 

maxi aula 2

, 

alle ore 9

Avanti No Tav!

Si parte e si torna insieme.

title: Profitabler öffentlicher Hafenbetrieb Duisport AG verweigert sich der Tarifbindung und betreibt Lohndumping
content:
Dossier


„

Während zuletzt private Hafenbetriebe im größten Binnenhafen der Welt in Duisburg Tarifverträge für ihre Beschäftigten mit der Gewerkschaft Verdi abgeschlossen haben, sträubt sich die öffentliche Duisport AG gegen eine solche Vereinbarung. Von »Schmuddelkind in der Branche« ist bei Verdi die Rede, da die Duisport AG auch im erweiterten Umfeld von Duisburg die Rolle eines Hebels zur Verschlechterung der Lohn- und Arbeitsbedingungen der Beschäftigten im Bereich der Häfen ausübe. Signalwirkung hätte eine tarifliche Bindung auch für Zulieferer und mit dem Duisburger Hafen in Geschäften stehende Betriebe allemal. (…) Der Duisburger Hafen ist organisiert und aufgeteilt in private Unternehmen, die Hauptbetreiber sind allerdings die städtischen Tochtergesellschaften, die als Duisport-Gruppe firmieren. Eigentümer sind zu zwei Dritteln das Land Nordrhein-Westfalen und zu einem Drittel die Stadt Duisburg

…“

Artikel von David Bieber vom 15.10.2025 in ND online


 („Duisport mauert bei Tarifverträgen“) – siehe Interviews mit dem ver.di- Gewerkschaftssekretär Sören Brandes und mehr Informationen:


[Der erste Prozess um Zahlungsansprüche am 23. Dezember 2026] Duisburger Hafen: Wo bleibt der Tariflohn?


„

Beschäftigte im Duisburger Hafen haben im Frühjahr einen Tarifvertrag erstritten, auf die vertragliche Bezahlung warten sie bis heute


Der Duisburger Hafen feiert in diesem Jahr seinen 100. Geburtstag. Geschichte und Zukunft des Logistikdrehkreuzes an Rhein und Ruhr sind im Blick der Feierlichkeiten und werden als eine große Erfolgsgeschichte dargestellt. Hafenarbeiter*innen erzählen derzeit allerdings andere Geschichten. Im Mittelpunkt steht die Duisport Logistics & Port Services (DLPS), ein 100-prozentiges Tochterunternehmen des Hafens, der wiederum zu zwei Dritteln im Besitz des Landes Nordrhein-Westfalen ist und zu einem Drittel der Stadt Duisburg gehört.


Bei DLPS gab es eine längere Tarifauseinandersetzung. Bis zum Mai 2024 war der Lagerbereich des Unternehmens an den Tarifvertrag der Speditions- und Logistikbranche NRW gebunden. Dann wechselte das Unternehmen im Arbeitgeberverband in eine Mitgliedschaft ohne Tarifbindung. Den Beschäftigten wurden im Anschluss individuelle Arbeitsverträge vorgelegt. Die meisten Beschäftigten unterschrieben die mit einigen Versprechungen versehenen neuen Arbeitsverträge.


Glücklich wurden die Hafenarbeiter mit den neuen Verträgen nicht. Sie entschlossen sich, gemeinsam mit Verdi für einen Tarifvertrag zu kämpfen. Der 2025 begonnene Weg dahin wurde von DLPS immer wieder verzögert. Die Auseinandersetzung gipfelte in einem 100-Tage-Ultimatum zum 1. Mai dieses Jahres und einer damit verbundenen Streikdrohung. Zwei Wochen vor Ablauf des Ultimatums kehrte DLPS in die Tarifbindung des Arbeitgeberverbands zurück.


Ende gut, alles gut? Mitnichten. Während Verdi den Standpunkt vertritt, dass der Tarifvertrag für alle 330 Beschäftigten von DLPS an sämtlichen Standorten gilt, sieht es das Unternehmen anders. Dort ist man der Auffassung, dass nur die Beschäftigten der ehemals tarifgebundenen Lagerbereiche vom Tarifvertag profitieren. Andere Gruppen im Betrieb, etwa Kranfahrer, sollen leer ausgehen. Ein Unding aus Sicht von Verdi. Die Kranführer hätten nach dem Tarifvertrag einen Anspruch von 1.659,68 Euro Urlaubsgeld im laufenden Jahr.


Auch die Beschäftigten im Lagerbereich, für die der Tarifvertrag nach Angaben von DLPS gelten soll, schauen in die Röhre. Ihre Löhne wurden bisher nicht angepasst. So fehlen den Beschäftigten monatlich 100 bis 250 Euro. Wann die Löhne angepasst werden sollen, bleibt unklar. DLPS hat angekündigt, die Beschäftigten zu Einzelgesprächen einzuladen. Für den Verdi-Sekretär Niels Holger Schmidt typisch für das Unternehmen: »Zeit zu schinden, ist eine maßgebliche Strategie von DLPS.« Inzwischen wurden mit Unterstützung von Verdi mehrere Dutzend individuelle Zahlungsansprüche gegenüber DLPS geltend gemacht. (…)


Um für die Umsetzung der Ansprüche zu sorgen, ziehen nun erste Beschäftigte, unterstützt von der Gewerkschaft, vor das Arbeitsgericht. Der Tarifvertrag soll endlich angewendet werden und die Beschäftigten sollen die verhandelte Entlohnung erhalten. Der erste Prozess ist für den 23. Dezember terminiert

.“

Artikel von Sebastian Weiermann vom 25.11.2026 in ND online

title: Gewerkschaften in Kanada starten Organisierungskampagne bei Amazon, beginnend in Nisku, Alberta
content:
Dossier


„

Die Teamsters Local 362 beantragte eine Abstimmung über die gewerkschaftliche Vertretung im Amazon YEG 1 Fulfillment Centre in Nisku, AB. Dies ist der erste Schritt in der Organisierungskampagne der Gewerkschaft Teamsters Canada, um Amazon an den Verhandlungstisch zu bringen. „Amazon wird sich ohne eine Gewerkschaft nicht ändern. Ob es um Arbeitsplatzsicherheit, Arbeitstempo, Diskriminierung, Günstlingswirtschaft oder Löhne geht, das Unternehmen hat bewiesen, dass es zutiefst arbeitnehmerfeindlich ist. (…)

Das Alberta Labour Relations Board (ALRB) muss den Antrag zunächst prüfen. Sobald dies geschehen ist, werden alle Amazon-Beschäftigten in YEG 1, die seit gestern angestellt sind, die Möglichkeit haben, über die Vertretung durch die Teamsters Local Union 362 abzustimmen

…“ So beginnt die engl.

Mitteilung vom 14. September 2021 bei Teamster Canada


, siehe die weitere Entwicklung:


Kanada: Amazon-MitarbeiterInnen in Delta erzielen – gegen massive Widerstände – einen dreijährigen Tarifvertrag – den ersten bei Amazon in Nordamerika


„

800 Beschäftigte im Amazon-Logistikzentrum YVR2 fallen nun unter einen verbindlichen Tarifvertrag, nachdem ein unabhängiger Schlichter am 13. November 2026 dessen Bedingungen festgelegt hat. Der Vertrag ist der erste für Amazon-Beschäftigte in ganz Nordamerika und sieht Lohnerhöhungen vor, durch die der Stundenlohn bis zum Ende der Vertragslaufzeit auf 29 Dollar steigt, sowie verbesserte Abfindungsansprüche von bis zu 18 Wochen und eine zusätzliche Urlaubswoche für Beschäftigte mit 10 Jahren Betriebszugehörigkeit.


„Amazon hat allen gesagt, dass es niemals einen Tarifvertrag geben würde, aber die Beschäftigten haben das Gegenteil bewiesen“, sagte Lana Payne, nationale Vorsitzende von Unifor. „Diese Beschäftigten haben sich gegen eines der mächtigsten Unternehmen der Welt gewehrt und sich Rechte schriftlich gesichert, die Amazon ihnen nicht mehr wegnehmen kann. Ihr Mut hat den Sieg gebracht.“


Die Arbeitsbeziehungsbehörde von British Columbia (B.C. Labour Relations Board) erkannte im Juli 2025 die Unifor-Ortsgruppe 114 als Gewerkschaft der Beschäftigten an, nachdem sie festgestellt hatte, dass Amazon zusätzliches Personal eingestellt hatte, um die Organisierungsbemühungen der Beschäftigten zu vereiteln, und eine „langwierige und allgegenwärtige gewerkschaftsfeindliche Kampagne“ geführt hatte. Am 4. August 2026 ordnete die Behörde ein verbindliches Schiedsverfahren an, da sie zu dem Schluss gekommen war, dass das Verhalten von Amazon die Fähigkeit der Parteien beeinträchtigt hatte, eine Einigung zu erzielen.


„Amazon hat versucht, die Beschäftigten davon zu überzeugen, dass das Unternehmen zu groß sei, um sich gewerkschaftlich zu organisieren, und hat seine Macht und sein Geld eingesetzt, um die Beschäftigten abzuschrecken, während es Milliarden an Gewinnen einfuhr. Das Unternehmen hat jede Entscheidung angefochten und bei jedem Schritt versucht, die Realität umzuschreiben, ist damit aber gescheitert“, sagte Gavin McGarrigle, Regionaldirektor für den Westen. „Diese Amazon-Beschäftigten haben nun den verbindlichen Tarifvertrag, den sie verdienen, und wir beabsichtigen, sie und Tausende weitere dabei zu unterstützen, ihre Lebensbedingungen zu verbessern – in British Columbia und anderswo.“


Zu den weiteren Errungenschaften des Dreijahresvertrags gehören eine Frauenbeauftragte, eine Lebensmittelzulage für die Dauer des Vertrags, die Einteilung der gesetzlichen Feiertage nach Dienstalter sowie Schutzmaßnahmen, die sicherstellen, dass die Sozialleistungen der Beschäftigten mindestens dem bisherigen Niveau entsprechen oder darüber liegen.


Der Vertrag läuft bis zum 13. November 2029. Unifor wird in den kommenden Tagen Informationsveranstaltungen für die YVR2-Mitglieder abhalten, um ihnen ihre neuen Rechte und deren Inanspruchnahme zu erläutern

…“ engl.

Unifor-Pressemitteilung vom 13. November 2026

author: Sophia Sheera
title: OpenAI and Anthropic Staff Say Latest Models Will Soon Be Able to ‘Trick Us’
content:
More than two dozen OpenAI and Anthropic employees say they are developing models too powerful to release safely.


Researchers are unable to control the most advanced models, at least

24 sources told Axios

, with some adding that company executives are out of touch with the magnitude of safety risks.


“If we continue trying to make models much smarter, such that they’re actually smarter than us… they will in fact be able to trick us successfully,” one researcher told the outlet. 


An Anthropic spokesperson said that holding a model back from public release but continuing to develop it “doesn’t make it safe”, adding: “Our responsibility starts in training.”


The latest models show signs of ‘gaming’ reward systems, including bypassing safety checks if it means the machines achieve higher scores, sources told Axios. Models are also arriving at conclusions without showing developers their work, with instances of models deliberately hiding their reasoning and coming up with cover stories.


On Sunday, OpenAI’s chief scientist Jakub Pachocki published information related to the company’s

pretraining methods

, proclaiming the importance of establishing shared safety measures across the industry and inviting other companies to do the same. 


Yet AI developers have resisted efforts to externally regulate the industry by

lobbying governments

 and emphasising the commercial risks of

slowing down innovation

, instead arguing that big tech must regulate itself. 


In September, former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon

warned

: “The people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade.”


“At Anthropic, the stakes are well-understood, but they are locked in a race to get there first,” he added. 


The UK’s National Cyber Security Centre said on Tuesday that it has seen a “

marked rise

” in cyberattacks aided by AI since September. Hackers are able to attack infrastructure with new speed and persistence thanks to cheap open models and illegal software resellers, the centre added.

author: CNT Jerez
title: 25N. Contra las violencias machistas, por la vida y la autonomía de las mujeres
content:
«La libertad no descenderá al pueblo, el pueblo debe ascender por sí mismo a la libertad». — Emma Goldman.


Otro 25 de noviembre, y otra vez nos faltan mujeres. Faltan 47 asesinadas por sus parejas o exparejas en lo que va de año, y 1.388 desde que existen registros oficiales. Cada número tuvo nombre, una casa, una familia que hoy la echa de menos y, muchas veces, hijos e hijas que crecen sin su madre.Y no es algo que pase lejos. Casi cinco millones de mujeres con pareja han sufrido violencia de género en España: una de cada tres. Más de 500 denuncian cada día.


Cada una de nosotras conoce a alguna: una vecina, una compañera de trabajo, una amiga, una prima. A veces nosotras mismas.


Porque la violencia machista no empieza ni acaba en un asesinato. Empieza mucho antes: en el control del dinero, en el «yo te doy el dinero que tu no sabes administrarlo», en el aislamiento, en el móvil que se revisa, en la ubicación compartida a la fuerza.


Y a menudo se queda atrapada en algo muy práctico: ¿adónde voy? Piensa en Carmen, que tuvo que salir de su casa casi con lo puesto para escapar de su pareja. ¿De qué sirve que nos digan que denunciemos si luego no hay vivienda, ni sueldo, ni nadie que nos sostenga? Es más difícil aún para las mujeres migrantes sin papeles, que temen perder la residencia, o para las que trabajan en precario y saben que irse puede significar perder también el único ingreso que tienen. Por eso exigimos casas de acogida, vivienda, atención psicológica y jurídica, y protección real para las supervivientes y sus hijas e hijos.


Que no nos traten como sospechosas cuando denunciamos. Que se nos escuche y se nos crea.


Y hay otra violencia que no deja marcas visibles, pero prepara el terreno para todas las demás: la que niega que existan. Hubo un tiempo en que la violencia machista no figuraba en las estadísticas. Hoy se mide, se documenta y se cuenta, y aun así hay quienes exigen debatir si es real. El discurso ultraderechista que habla de «invento ideológico», de «violencia sin género» o de denuncias falsas masivas ha pasado del margen al titular, a la tribuna institucional y al algoritmo. Y está calando:

el negacionismo entre la juventud se duplicó entre 2019 y 2023, del 11,9% al 23,1% en los chicos y del 5,7% al 13,2% en las chicas,

 y cuatro de cada diez jóvenes condenan estas conductas pero las perciben como algo inevitable y que siempre a pasado.


No hace falta convencer a nadie de que la violencia es buena: basta con que parezca normal, exagerada o imposible de cambiar.


Ahí está el mecanismo de la insensibilización. Cada vez que se repite que las víctimas mienten, que las leyes son un negocio o que el feminismo es adoctrinamiento, el umbral de lo tolerable baja un poco.

La mujer que denuncia empieza a calcular si la creerán. El agresor se siente respaldado.

 La chica y el chico que reciben ese mensaje en redes lo incorporan como sentido común antes de haber vivido una sola relación. Por eso estos discursos también son violencia: erosionan la credibilidad de las víctimas, desincentivan la denuncia, deslegitiman a quienes acompañan y convierten una emergencia social en una guerra cultural. Una sociedad acostumbrada a que se niegue el dolor ajeno termina por no verlo.


Y lo vemos ya en la gente joven, en nuestras propias casas y barrios: el 61,4% de las chicas piensa que la desigualdad de género es grande o muy grande, y solo lo piensa el 36,7% de los chicos. Más de la mitad de ellos (54,1%) cree que el hombre está desprotegido ante las denuncias falsas. Estamos creciendo con dos realidades distintas, y eso nos tiene que preocupar a todas y a todos.


Pero no vamos a retroceder. Nos precede una larga historia de mujeres que rompieron el silencio. Ellas nos enseñaron que lo que nos dijeron que era un problema de casa es un problema de todas.

Seguimos aquí por el derecho a decidir sobre nuestros cuerpos, por el consentimiento, por el aborto libre y seguro, por poder vivir sin miedo y con un sueldo que no dependa de nadie.


Y lo hacemos desde el apoyo mutuo, porque la emancipación no se regala: se conquista, organizándonos en el trabajo, en el sindicato y en el barrio.

Porque no queremos más mujeres asesinadas. Porque no queremos más criaturas huérfanas ni víctimas de violencia vicaria. Porque ninguna mujer debería tener que elegir entre su seguridad y su supervivencia económica. Porque ninguna debería necesitar una denuncia, una orden judicial o una tragedia para que las instituciones …

author: Acratosaurio rex
title: ¿Es menos malo matar a 125 que a 500?
content:
Aquí, un fusilamiento para evitar males mayores


Colegas, votad lo que creáis conveniente, y yo a lo mío: La cuestión es la siguiente con lo del Mal Menor: a mí me enseñaron a pensar de otro modo. No existe el mal menor. Existe el Mal. Os lo explico.


Imaginar una negociación laboral. La empresa quiere despedir a 500 trabajadores, pero vienen los sindicatos a negociar y consiguen que solo se despidan a 125. Pero ademas se hace un referéndum, y la propuesta sale adelante. Ese es el Mal Menor, y se presenta tal cosa como una gran victoria.


Ahora cambia “despido” por “fusilamiento”, y piensa: ¿cómo queda esa mandanga? ¿No es mejor que mueran 125 en lugar de 500? Y además con referéndum. Pues eso díselo a los muertos. Realmente, hemos asesinado, a 125 personas.


¿Y si el verdadero drama fuera obligarnos a elegir entre dos males, haciéndonos creer que somos responsables de resolver una tragedia que no hemos creado? Porque la pregunta que me hago no es cuál vida debemos sacrificar, sino… ¿quién cuernos me ha colocado en la posición de supuestamente decidir esta gran cagada? Porque pasado mañana, tras votar, seguiremos teniendo centros de internamiento, muertes en el Estrecho, colegios gueto y patriarcado. Y eso amigos y amigas, es el Mal, o dicho de otro modo, un montón enorme de olorosa mierda.

author: Unknown
title: Reconnaître le génocide colonial en Algérie
content:
La France a commis un génocide en Algérie, bien avant la guerre d'indépendance de 1954 à 1962.

 C'est la position que je défends ici, en revenant sur les premières décennies de la conquête, de 1830 à 1871. Pour comprendre cette histoire, il faut regarder les méthodes employées par l'armée française, leurs conséquences sur les populations et les objectifs que les responsables coloniaux formulaient eux-mêmes.


En effet, derrière le récit d'une conquête suivie d'une «

 

pacification

 

», on trouve des villages incendiés, des familles massacrées, des récoltes détruites et des populations chassées de leurs terres. Ces violences ont permis l'installation d'une colonie de peuplement, au prix de la destruction des sociétés qui occupaient déjà le territoire. [1]


Conquérir un pays déjà habité et organisé


En 1830, l'Algérie est une régence liée à l'Empire ottoman, disposant d'une large autonomie. Le dey gouverne depuis Alger, tandis que de nombreuses communautés conservent leurs propres formes d'organisation. La conquête française s'attaque donc à une société existante, avec ses institutions, ses terres cultivées et ses réseaux de solidarité.


L'affaire du coup d'éventail, en 1827, fournit le prétexte diplomatique à l'intervention. Trois ans plus tard, les troupes françaises débarquent et prennent Alger. Mais occuper une ville ne suffit pas à soumettre le pays. Face aux résistances, notamment celle menée par l'émir Abd el-Kader, la conquête se prolonge et la violence s'étend aux populations civiles.


Détruire les moyens de vivre


Sous Bugeaud, la terre brûlée devient une méthode de guerre. Les colonnes militaires ravagent les villages, incendient les récoltes, vident les réserves et s'emparent du bétail. Les razzias permettent ainsi de frapper les moyens de subsistance des habitants, pour briser leur capacité à résister. [1]


Il faut bien comprendre ce que cela implique. Lorsqu'une armée détruit les champs et les réserves alimentaires, les conséquences continuent après son départ. Les familles perdent de quoi manger, semer et traverser la mauvaise saison. Elles sont poussées à la fuite ou à la soumission, tandis que la faim devient un instrument de domination.


La violence atteint aussi directement les personnes réfugiées. En juin 1845, dans le massif du Dahra, les troupes du colonel Pélissier allument des feux aux entrées des grottes où se sont retranchés les Ouled Riah. Des centaines de personnes meurent asphyxiées, parmi lesquelles des femmes et des enfants. C'est le principe des enfumades, tuer par la fumée des populations enfermées dans leur refuge. [1]


Comment réduire de tels actes à de simples «

 

excès

 

» de soldats

 

? Les massacres et les destructions prennent place dans une stratégie qui vise les communautés jusque dans leurs conditions d'existence. La terreur doit rendre toute résistance impossible.


La spoliation au service du peuplement colonial


La conquête se poursuit également par la dépossession. Pour installer des colons, il faut prendre les terres et déplacer ceux qui les habitent. Le droit colonial participe à cette opération, en imposant ses catégories de propriété et en fragilisant les droits existants, notamment collectifs. La violence militaire trouve ainsi un prolongement administratif. [2]


Perdre sa terre, dans une société où elle permet de se nourrir, c'est perdre une grande partie de son autonomie. Les expulsions désorganisent les communautés et leurs solidarités. Elles rendent les populations plus vulnérables aux crises alimentaires, tandis que la colonisation transforme le territoire à son profit.


La catastrophe de 1866 à 1868 intervient dans ce contexte. Les crises agricoles et sanitaires frappent des populations déjà appauvries et fragilisées par la domination coloniale. La famine s'inscrit dans ce processus de destruction, dont l'attaque délibérée des moyens d'alimentation constitue un ressort essentiel. On ne peut donc pas séparer les morts de faim du système qui a ravagé les ressources et dépossédé les habitants. [3]


Pourquoi je parle de génocide


Le mot a un sens précis. L'article

II

 de la Convention des Nations unies de 1948 vise des actes commis avec l'intention de détruire, totalement ou partiellement, un groupe national, ethnique, racial ou religieux. Il mentionne notamment les meurtres, les atteintes graves à l'intégrité physique ou mentale et l'imposition de conditions d'existence entraînant la destruction physique du groupe. Il ne faut donc pas que …

author: Unknown
title: Fidan Ataselim: Repression and violence rise as democracy is eroded
content:
The We Will Stop Femicide Platform (KCDP) took to the streets across the country ahead of 25 November, the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women, to protest the cover-up of the growing number of suspicious deaths of women under the slogan, "Stop the cover-ups, shed light on suspicious deaths of women." Families of women killed by male violence stood at the forefront of demonstrations in Istanbul's Kadıköy district, demanding an end to systematic impunity and the effective implementation of Law No. 6284. We Will Stop Femicide Platform Secretary General Fidan Ataselim spoke to ANF and said that the increase in femicides and suspicious deaths of women cannot be separated from the policies of the Justice and Development Party (AKP), adding, "Violence increases as democracy is eroded."


'Women's deaths are being concealed in the name of protecting the family'


KCDP Secretary General Fidan Ataselim, who has been fighting against femicide for years, said that they took to the streets on this year's International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women to draw particular attention to the growing number of suspicious deaths of women. Fidan Ataselim said that the increase in male violence against women cannot be considered independently of the AKP's policies: "This is a consequence of the government's 'Decade of Family and Population' policies. We repeatedly warned against this, but they did not listen. Women are most often killed within the family by the men closest to them. If you say that 'the family is important,' not only are women killed, but their deaths also begin to be concealed. Indeed, femicides and suspicious deaths of women have increased as a result of these family-centered policies."


'A strong response to rights violations can prevent further violations'


Fidan Ataselim said that 247 femicides and 289 suspicious deaths of women were recorded in the first ten months of 2026 alone, pointing out that suspicious deaths of women have increased significantly, just like femicides. Fidan Ataselim said that violence against women cannot be explained solely through family policies and must be considered in conjunction with the restriction of democratic rights and freedoms in the country: "Everything is so interconnected and forms part of a whole. Those who support the appointment of trustees, those who support the annulment of elections and those who profiteer from funding, when you consider them all together, you see that once you begin to undermine democracy, you also undermine every relationship in which democracy plays a role. For example, the family is promoted as the smallest unit of society and the foundation of property ownership, creating conditions in which women are disregarded within the family and subjected to treatment that goes even beyond slavery. The AKP's definition of the family is limited to families that resemble them and conform to their mindset and interests. They want a uniform family model. We already see this in their overall policies. Repression and violence increase as democracy is eroded. This repression and violence increase not only against women but against society as a whole. However, the first targets of this repression and violence are women, who are relegated to the very bottom of all inequalities. Beyond women, we also see what LGBTQ+ people are experiencing today. They said, 'My family is safe,' and shelved the entire issue of freedom of association. That is why we always say that no one can disregard equal citizenship. There is such a thing as equal citizenship, the right to organize and freedom of expression. When were these rights of ours shelved? Yet they are able to do this in practice through repression. That is why I say that repression and violence increase as democracy is undermined. This repression and violence are not only increasing but are also being concealed, as we see in suspicious deaths of women. This situation cannot be separated from the struggle for democracy. If a strong response is mounted when such rights violations occur, further violations can be prevented. However, when no response is possible, these violations spread, as they do today. The attitude of saying, 'This person is not one of us, that person is not one of us,' ultimately leaves everyone in the same situation, with trustees being appointed everywhere."

title: '1001 Signatures for a Democratic Republic and Peace' initiative issues four-point declaration
content:
The '1001 Signatures for a Democratic Republic and Peace' initiative, formed by artists, academics and human rights defenders, will publicly announce its “Seven Climates, Seven Regions” campaign, launched as part of its signature drive, at a press conference to be held at the Taksim Hill Hotel in Istanbul’s Beyoğlu district today.


In a statement, the initiative said it would put forward a concrete vision for peace and the peace process under the slogan: “A better country is possible for all of us, across seven climates and seven regions.”


The statement emphasised the need to strengthen collective voices and determination in order to heal the wounds of the past, develop solutions to present-day problems together and build the future collectively.


The four-point declaration issued by the initiative highlights the following demands:


"- In the context of the ongoing peace process in Turkey, we support disarmament as an initial step and the complete removal of all forms of violence from the country's and society's agenda.


- Recognising that the root cause of the problem lies in the denial of Kurdish existence, we support demands for equal citizenship to be constitutionally guaranteed, for rights relating to education and instruction in one's mother tongue to be recognised, and for efforts to address historical injustices.


- We support efforts to establish the Republic of Turkey on the foundations of a free, democratic state governed by the rule of law, as well as demands for the full implementation of European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) rulings.


- We support ensuring that the actors involved in resolving this conflict, which has persisted throughout the history of the Republic of Turkey, are able to negotiate under free and equal conditions. We also support the implementation of the principle of the

Right to Hope

, in line with ECtHR rulings and the demands of the Council of Europe's Committee of Ministers."

author: Unknown
title: Applications for violence and rights violations in Amed increase by 36%
content:
The Amed Network Against Violence has published its 2026 Violence Report, covering the period from 23 November 2025 to 23 November 2026.


Speaking at the presentation, held at the Tahir Elçi Conference Hall of the Amed Bar Association, lawyer Zilan Esen stated that, according to the network’s shared database, 7,145 applications had been recorded in the city. This represents a 36% increase compared with the previous year, when 5,253 applications were registered.


According to the report, applications relating to psychological violence increased by 34.4%, economic violence by 58.7%, physical violence by 43.7% and sexual violence by 27.2%.


Cases of intentional homicide rose from 4 to 17, an increase of 325%, while attempted intentional homicide cases increased from 14 to 18. In addition, five suspicious deaths were recorded.


Reports of torture and ill-treatment increased from 9 to 80, cases of pressure by law enforcement from 3 to 22, and incidents of ill-treatment in prisons from 4 to 14.


The report also stated that four assaults and one murder targeting LGBTI+ people had been recorded.


The network called for the Istanbul Convention to be reinstated, the effective implementation of Law No. 6284, effective investigations into cases of violence against women, and the expansion of free legal assistance and shelter services.


The statement concluded with the slogan “Jin, jiyan, azadî” (Woman, life, freedom).

author: Unknown
title: Bihar Munzîr: Violence and killings persist where women are not free
content:
Bihar Munzîr, an executive of the People's Development Organization (PDO), spoke to ANF about the situation of women in Southern Kurdistan (Başûr) as events and marches are taking place this week for the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women. Bihar Munzîr drew attention to femicides, cases of self-immolation among women, child marriages and shortcomings in the implementation of laws, saying, "Femicides and cases of self-immolation remain at high levels. Last year, 69 women were killed."


Femicides and cases of self-immolation remain high


Bihar Munzîr said that violence against women remains at high levels in Southern Kurdistan, with femicides and cases of self-immolation among women constituting some of the most severe forms of violence. According to the organization's statistics, 69 women were killed in the Kurdistan Region last year by close family members, including their husbands, brothers or fathers.


Munzîr also addressed child marriages, saying that numerous attempts had been made to introduce legislation incompatible with human and children's rights following amendments to Iraq's Personal Status Law. However, she said that the legislation was not directly implemented in the Kurdistan Region.


Perpetrators of femicide go unpunished


Munzîr said that there were serious shortcomings in the implementation of laws in the Kurdistan Region, particularly in cases involving femicide and violence against women, and that disputes were often settled through tribal reconciliation mechanisms. She added that perpetrators either went unpunished or had their prison sentences reduced, emphasizing the need for sanctions that would prevent such crimes from recurring.


Munzîr underlined that there were numerous shortcomings and problems in the implementation of laws, adding, "Tribes and relatives of perpetrators frequently interfere in cases involving femicide and violence against women." She stressed that laws in the Kurdistan Region still failed to guarantee equality between women and men in certain areas and drew attention to the issue of polygamy. She explained that a man who was already married in the Kurdistan Region could officially register a second marriage elsewhere.


Patriarchal society makes decisions about women's lives


Munzîr said that one of the fundamental problems in the Kurdistan Region was women's inability to make decisions about their own lives and drew attention to the influence of tribes and patriarchal social structures over women's lives. She said that these structures remained the determining forces rather than strong women's institutions and the rule of law.


Munzîr added that women remained subject to social control when they could not make their own decisions about their lives, education and employment. "If a woman is not free, if someone else makes decisions about her life and controls her, she becomes an easy target for violence and killing," she remarked.


Munzîr said that women's and human rights organizations were carrying out important work to document violations against women, prepare reports, exert pressure and raise public awareness despite institutional shortcomings. She said that these efforts needed to be supported by a more comprehensive program and strategy.


A free and safe society must be built


PDO executive Bihar Munzîr drew attention to the campaign launched by the March 8 Network and other organizations against femicides and cases of self-immolation among women. She said that the campaign, conducted in the Kurdistan Region, Kirkuk (Kerkûk) and abroad, was a long-term initiative and emphasized the importance of raising public awareness through the media, art and various activities.


Munzîr added that everyone must assume their responsibilities and that institutions must be mobilized to prevent femicides and cases of self-immolation among women. She called for the construction of a society in which women and all people are free and safe.

title: İstanbul Boğazı'nda gemi trafiği askıya alındı
content:
Rusya'da insansız hava aracı (İHA) saldırısına uğradıktan sonra Giresun açıklarına kadar sürüklenen 'Fortis' isimli kuru yük gemisi, İstanbul Boğazı'ndan geçiriliyor. Boğaz trafiği çift yönlü olarak geçici süreyle askıya alınırken, geçiş dronla havadan görüntülendi.

Rusya'nın Novorossiysk Limanı'ndan Mersin'e gitmek üzere hareket eden Rus bayraklı kuru yük gemisi 'Fortis', ekim ayında Karadeniz'de İHA saldırısına uğrayarak hasar aldı. Saldırının ardından 3 bin 300 tonluk geminin 10 mürettebatı tahliye edildi. Giresun açıklarına sürüklenen gemi, Keşap kıyılarına alınarak kurtarma ve soğutma çalışmaları yapıldı. Marinsal 3 isimli römorkör tarafından çekilerek İstanbul Boğazı'na getirilen gemi, Kıyı Emniyeti Genel Müdürlüğü'ne bağlı Kurtarma 3, Kurtarma 9 ve Mehmetçik römorkörleri eşliğinde boğazdan geçiriliyor.

Gemide yapılan incelemenin ardından hurdaya ayrılmasına karar verildiği, Aliağa tersanelerine götürüldükten sonra söküm işleminin gerçekleştirileceği öğrenildi. Geminin geçişi nedeniyle İstanbul Boğazı'nda gemi trafiği çift yönlü olarak geçici süreyle askıya alındı.

content:

Juntas somos más fuertes.

author: Brian Hioe
title: What is the Future of KMT-TPP Cooperation?
content:
THE KMT AND TPP’S future cooperation–or lack thereof–has increasingly become questioned in the course of elections.

The TPP would seem to be at a crossroads. The party was originally built as a vehicle for party founder Ko Wen-je’s bid for the presidency. But Ko is likely to return to jail soon on corruption charges over accepting bribes to expand the floor area of the Core Pacific City Mall.

With Huang Kuo-chang as the party’s acting chair, the party has lost many of its previous visible political figures. As many were Ko associates, it is possible that Huang drove them out of the party in his quest to maintain power of the party, with Huang having historically not been part of the TPP before suddenly taking leadership. This occurs even as Huang publicly vows fidelity to Ko and his ideals.

Likewise, though the TPP could have controlled the balance of power in the legislature by playing the DPP and KMT off from each other and, in that way, becoming the “kingmaker” within the Legislative Yuan, this has not occurred. Instead, the TPP has simply sided with the KMT on most policy initiatives–even highly controversial ones, such as drastically slashing the government budget, freezing the Constitutional Court, or expanding legislative powers.

This apparent lack of awareness that the party’s best interests were served by counter-balancing between the KMT and DPP, in line with the party’s claim to be beyond traditional partisan divisions in Taiwanese politics, is probably due to the fact that the majority of its politicians come from pan-Blue backgrounds. It may have been path dependency that caused the TPP to become overly reliant on the KMT.

ONE NOTES that party chair Huang Kuo-chang originally planned to run for New Taipei mayor, given that he was formerly a legislator of Xizhi. But Huang backed out in favor of Lee Shu-chuan of the KMT when polling results showed a stronger performance by Lee. That Lee is struggling against Su Chiao-hui of the DPP may make it sting that the KMT passed over Huang.

There are some places where the KMT has declined to run a candidate, but instead decided to back a TPP one. Hsinchu city mayor Ann Kao, for example, is still often regarded as part of the TPP despite technically being an independent, having departed the party after facing corruption charges that she was later acquitted of. Kao is running with the backing of the KMT and TPP, though she has often used the KMT’s blue when campaigning.

Chiayi City is another constituency where a TPP candidate is running with the endorsement of the KMT and TPP. However, the TPP candidate there, Chiang Chi-kai, recently courted controversy after being caught on camera urinating in public on a bush while on the campaign trail.

Still, splits opened up between the KMT and TPP in Zhubei, the administrative capital of Hsinchu County. There, the KMT has nominated Wu Hsu-chih, while the TPP has nominated Chiu Chen-yuan, but neither candidate agreed to back out in favor of the other.

As such, this led KMT chair Cheng Li-wun to declare an end to political cooperation between the KMT and TPP in Hsinchu County as a whole. This has not prevented Chiang Wan-an and pan-Blue commentator Jaw Shaw-kong from making public appearances with Chiu, in what has been questioned as potentially violating party discipline. That both party heavyweights have been willing to break from party discipline may reflect that Cheng’s grip over the KMT is quite weak at present.

Oppositely, in Hualien, the TPP county branch chair, Chang Tien-min, broke from party discipline to endorse independent Chang Chun rather than KMT nominee Yu Shu-chen. Chang has criticized Yu as beholden to KMT legislative caucus chair Fu Kun-chi’s political dynasty, which has historically dominated Hualien.

IN EVALUATING the current state of TPP-KMT relations, then, one sees cooperation in some districts while open competition in others. It is generally thought that current KMT chair Cheng Li-wun does not favor cooperating with the TPP, seeing it as splitting votes from the KMT and being an unnecessary collaborator, while others in the KMT, such as Chiang Wan-an, cling to the TPP as part of an attempt to rally votes.

Indeed, in the meantime, with days until the vote, the TPP’s alignment with Chiang Wan-an has strengthened in what increasingly looks like a desperate attempt by Chiang to fend off challenger Puma Shen. Chiang appeared at the TPP’s rally last Saturday in front of City Hall and was later …

title: Herbstzauber im Pappelwäldchen – Unterwegs mit Dackel Börne
content:
Der Herbst zeigt sich von seiner schönsten Seite!


Begleitet uns auf einem gemütlichen Spaziergang durch das Pappelwäldchen in Ennigerloh. Zwischen bunten Blättern, herbstlichen Farben und der besonderen Ruhe des Waldes genießen wir die Natur und lassen einfach mal die Seele baumeln.


Natürlich darf einer dabei nicht fehlen: Unser Dackel Börne! 🐶 Mit seiner neugierigen Nase und seiner ganz eigenen Art macht er jeden Spaziergang zu einem kleinen Abenteuer.


Diese Dia-Show fängt einige schöne Augenblicke eines herbstlichen Ausflugs ein – ganz ohne Hektik, dafür mit viel Natur, frischer Luft und kleinen Momenten zum Genießen.


Denn bei Operation Münsterland geht es nicht darum, immer etwas Großes zu erleben. Manchmal sind es gerade die kleinen Ausflüge vor der Haustür, die besonders schön sind.


Viel Spaß beim Anschauen!

author: Gabriel Teles
title: O lado oculto da Black Friday
content:
Todos os anos, quando chega a Black Friday, voltam a circular denúncias sobre as estratégias utilizadas pelas empresas para

enganar

 os consumidores. A mais conhecida delas consiste em aumentar artificialmente os preços nas semanas anteriores, para depois anunciar descontos que, na realidade, pouco ou nada representam. É a famosa promoção pela “metade do dobro”.


Essas práticas merecem ser denunciadas. Entretanto,

existe um aspecto mais profundo da Black Friday que raramente aparece nas discussões públicas: a exploração e a precarização do trabalho daqueles que tornam possível a circulação de milhões de mercadorias em um intervalo tão curto.


Por trás das propagandas, dos descontos e das promessas de entrega rápida, existe uma extensa infraestrutura logística sustentada pelo trabalho de milhares de pessoas.

São trabalhadores que descarregam caminhões, recebem mercadorias, organizam estoques, separam pedidos, embalam produtos e preparam encomendas para expedição.

 Sem essas atividades, nenhuma das grandes plataformas de comércio eletrônico conseguiria cumprir aquilo que promete aos consumidores.


A dimensão dessa infraestrutura pode ser percebida pelos próprios números do setor. Segundo

projeções

 da Associação Brasileira de Inteligência Artificial e E-commerce (Abiacom), a semana da Black Friday de 2026 deverá movimentar aproximadamente R$ 16,6 bilhões no comércio eletrônico brasileiro, crescimento de 24,4% em relação ao mesmo período de 2025. A quantidade de pedidos deverá passar de 16,51 milhões para 21,66 milhões, um aumento de 31,2% em apenas um ano.


Essas milhões de mercadorias precisam ser movimentadas em um período curto. Cada pedido realizado pelo consumidor corresponde a uma sequência de operações, desde a localização do produto no estoque até sua expedição e entrega. Uma das principais respostas empresariais consiste na contratação massiva de trabalhadores temporários.


Somente neste mês de novembro de 2026 a Amazon anunciou a abertura de 12 mil vagas temporárias para atender ao aumento da demanda durante a Black Friday.

 A empresa

informou

 também que sua infraestrutura logística brasileira havia alcançado 350 unidades, após a abertura de mais de 120 instalações desde a Black Friday anterior.


A DHL Supply Chain, uma das maiores empresas de logística do mundo, anunciou a previsão de contratar aproximadamente 2,6 mil trabalhadores temporários adicionais durante a temporada de Black Friday e Natal.

 Esse contingente representa um aumento de 38% nas contratações temporárias em relação a um mês convencional. A empresa

projeta

 movimentar mais de 37 milhões de unidades no comércio eletrônico durante o período, volume 19% superior ao de um mês convencional.


A Americanas, por sua vez,

anunciou

 mais de 3,7 mil vagas temporárias, das quais aproximadamente 760 seriam destinadas às operações logísticas.


Os anúncios empresariais apresentam essas contratações como oportunidades de emprego e demonstrações do dinamismo econômico do setor.

Entretanto, grande parte desse contingente de temporários trabalha sob rotinas exaustivas, com funções repetitivas e metas rígidas, altamente vigiados por sistemas tecnológicos, além de não terem segurança do que vai acontecer quando o período de vendas passa. 


A legislação brasileira reconhece o trabalho temporário como modalidade destinada a atender necessidades transitórias de substituição de pessoal ou demandas complementares de serviços. Quando a demanda diminui, as empresas podem reduzir o contingente sem necessariamente incorporar aqueles que foram mobilizados para sustentar a expansão das vendas.


Centro de Distribuição da Amazon em Recife, inaugurado em 2024


O que acontece dentro dos galpões?


Em abril de 2025, publiquei no

Le Monde Diplomatique

 o artigo

Galpões logísticos e os novos rostos da exploração

, no qual discutia como a expansão do comércio eletrônico estava acompanhada pela constituição de novos espaços de exploração do trabalho.


Naquele momento, chamei atenção para uma contradição: as grandes plataformas anunciavam uma economia cada vez mais automatizada, enquanto seus centros de distribuição continuavam dependendo de uma imensa quantidade de trabalho humano, submetido a formas sofisticadas de controle da produtividade.


Desde então, minha pesquisa em sociologia do trabalho permitiu avançar na investigação desse processo.
